shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.edit: This is an edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph. Change only what the instruction names.

assets.item: It is soup. / It is a sandwich. / It is salad. / It is cheese.
assets.prompt: A CAFE TABLE seen from above, with four separate dishes in a row from left to right, well apart: a bowl of hot tomato SOUP; one SANDWICH on a small board; a bowl of green leaf SALAD; a wedge of yellow CHEESE on a small board. Nothing else on the table. Exactly four subjects, spread evenly across the whole width of the photo, each clearly separated from the others by open space, none overlapping or hidden, each large and sharp. Eye-level view, the whole of every subject visible. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.

assets.item: It is a cup. / It is a glass. / It is a bottle. / It is a plate.
assets.prompt: A CAFE TABLE seen from the side at eye level, with four EMPTY things standing in a row from left to right, well apart: a white coffee CUP on its saucer; a clear drinking GLASS; a tall green glass BOTTLE; a round white PLATE standing upright on a small stand so its face is seen. Nothing in any of them; nothing else on the table. Exactly four subjects, spread evenly across the whole width of the photo, each clearly separated from the others by open space, none overlapping or hidden, each large and sharp. Eye-level view, the whole of every subject visible. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.
